_comment: Item condition (backend/item_condition.py): every quality-tracked item instance carries quality 4..1 = new, used, damaged, broken, whatever its tier. Each use may drop it one level; below broken the item is gone. Broken still works like new - it's the warning before it's lost. Stacked items (no quality) instead have a small chance to lose one unit per use. Chances are 0..1.

foraging._comment: Rolled once per trip per gear piece, only when the trip found something of at least its tier (a bow's weapon roll only when its ammo didn't cover a find). stackLoss: a stacked gathering item (whetstone, iron spikes, tinderbox for a light...) loses one unit.

nights._comment: Each night out, each carried tent/bedroll may be used up (on top of the storm tent loss in foraging-rules.json).

crafting._comment: A borrowed tool - a tool item (axe, dagger...) or a crafting station (anvil, furnace, loom...) - drops one level with toolPerUnit for each item crafted, added up over the batch into one roll at the end, at most toolMax. Every tool only crafts recipes at its own tier or below.
